sloka: न तेषु अहस्सु श्रान्तो वा क्षुधितो वा न दृश्यते ।न अविद्वान् ब्राह्मणः कश्चिन् न अशत अनुचरः तथा ॥१-१४-११॥
transliteration: na teṣu ahassu śrānto vā kṣudhito vā na dṛśyate ।na avidvān brāhmaṇaḥ kaścin na aśata anucaraḥ tathā ॥1-14-11॥

translations.english: The aged, the sick, women and also children ate there and knew no limit to their enjoyment.
